title: A Paused Film, a QR Scan, and No More Lost Movie Nights | vitalii.no
description:
When a kid's screen time ran out, the parental guard used to cover the app with the kiosk or send it to the launcher — effective for cutting the TV off, but it threw away exactly where the film was. A parent's unlock scan then had to relaunch the app, and the child had to find their place in the movie again.

This one was built twice in one evening. The first version pressed the media pause key and drew a parent QR code over the kiosk while the background task tried to resume automatically — but on this Android build, the automatic return didn't work. So the fix moved onto the stick itself: a focusable full-screen overlay now loads the parent scan page directly over the still-visible paused film, swallowing all remote key presses so the film can't restart behind it.

Before: a kick lost the child's place and a parent's unlock meant relaunching from scratch. After: the paused film stays on screen through the whole wait, and one QR scan resumes it instantly. The fallback route now waits fifteen seconds in place before trying anything else.
